verdict.rationale: Apify provides the building blocks for this workflow — scheduled Actor runs (apify-docs-6/35), webhooks to trigger notifications on run completion (apify-docs-14/29), and performance/data-quality alerting (apify-docs-7) — plus marketing language about tracking competitors and real-time data (apify-docs-36). However, there is no dedicated first-party 'content change detection' feature (e.g., automatic diffing of scraped content or built-in price/listing change alerts) documented; a data-engineer would need to assemble schedule+scrape+compare+webhook themselves. Missing for 10: a documented change-detection/diffing Actor or built-in alerting specifically for content changes, and independent evidence of this exact use case working end-to-end.
